description: This file defines a PHP script that renders a subpanel view for associating users with roles in the SuiteCRM platform. It constructs a form with hidden inputs, assigns templates, and initializes a ListView object to display user data related to roles.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in the SuiteCRM platform, managing templates and data display for subpanels.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes a new template for rendering the list view using the specified HTML template and language strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the XTemplate engine for rendering in the associated HTML template.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title of the list view.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Defines the query parameters for fetching data to be displayed.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Adds header text or HTML (such as buttons) to the list view's display.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes the list view, rendering data based on the initialized template and query.
